format_query_code: format all TSP source files in a directory into a single templated query string
parse_code_block: parse a single code block delimited by triple at signs from formatted text
parse_output_code: parse all ten TSP code blocks from formatted output text into a dictionary
save_parsed_output_code: save a parsed code dictionary back to individual files in a target directory
review_parse_code_block: review the parse_code_block function to understand how it extracts code between triple at sign delimiters
